disclosure: Working browser demo · captured interaction states
presentation: Silent edited sequence of real CUA-captured browser states. Separate editorial captions; no simulated clicks, continuous-recording claim, speed benchmark, or unverified payment claim.

facts.ai: Local trained multinomial Naive Bayes: category suggestions, not cost decisions
facts.facts_source: Owner-confirmed genuine Sandbox OAuth, create, send-then-GET and separate Alex refresh. Final real 01–12 and 11b captures; PayPal buyer invoice visibly retains $52.58 amount due. No buyer payment or PAID operation executed.

scenes.title: A shared receipt needs decisions.
scenes.caption: A plotter team shares a cart, but not every part. The original source stays visible while costs are reviewed.
scenes.capture_expected: Actual synthetic source ledger with four flagged rows and eight pending source decisions
scenes.editorial_fact: Original synthetic project · typed receipt and bill of materials

scenes.title: Exclude a duplicate. Preserve its source.
scenes.caption: The second screw entry is excluded from billing with a reason. Its original $2.80 source row remains in the record.
scenes.capture_expected: Actual duplicate-row review with exclusion and entered reason
scenes.editorial_fact: Receipt amount and reviewed billing decision remain distinct

scenes.title: An extra belt needs an explanation.
scenes.caption: The BOM requests two belts; the receipt contains three. The reviewer records the spare's purpose and cost owner.
scenes.capture_expected: Actual extra belt source comparison and reviewed spare reason
scenes.editorial_fact: Source checks flag a difference; the model does not invent a purchase explanation

scenes.title: A model suggestion is not a cost decision.
scenes.caption: The local trained model is uncertain about Bench tidy kit. Its original category, score and supporting term are inspectable.
scenes.capture_expected: Actual 40% electronics suggestion for the ambiguous source item
scenes.editorial_fact: Statistical text classifier · displayed scores are uncalibrated

scenes.title: Correct the suggestion. Keep the evidence.
scenes.caption: The reviewer chooses Shop supplies, all three members and a reason. The original model output remains visible.
scenes.capture_expected: Actual category override, selected owners and entered review reason
scenes.editorial_fact: The model suggests; the reviewer confirms the category and cost owners

scenes.title: Every reviewed cent has an owner.
scenes.caption: $112.95 minus the $2.80 exclusion gives $110.15: Alex $52.58, Mina $32.69, Jules $24.88. Unallocated: $0.00.
scenes.capture_expected: Actual named member shares, original receipt total, reviewed total, excluded amount and completed 8/8 source review
scenes.editorial_fact: Integer-cent allocation · source IDs retained on each share

scenes.title: Confirm recipients before creating drafts.
scenes.caption: A separate confirmation shows the three generated Sandbox recipients and their reviewed amounts.
scenes.capture_expected: Actual recipient/amount confirmation before remote draft creation
scenes.editorial_fact: Sandbox test accounts only · credentials stay on the server

scenes.title: Three genuine PayPal Sandbox drafts.
scenes.caption: OAuth and invoice creation succeeded against PayPal Sandbox. These actual INV2 draft IDs match the reviewed shares.
scenes.capture_expected: Actual three returned INV2 drafts: $52.58, $32.69 and $24.88
scenes.editorial_fact: DRAFT is not issued or paid · no offline fixture substitution

scenes.title: Issuing is a separate decision.
scenes.caption: The invoice amount and recipient are confirmed again before the Sandbox issue request.
scenes.editorial_fact: An issued invoice is still not a buyer payment

scenes.title: Read the provider's actual response.
scenes.caption: PayPal Sandbox returned SENT for all three invoices. A separate refresh for Alex also returned SENT; buyer payment has not occurred.
scenes.capture_expected: Actual three returned SENT invoices and separate refreshed-status confirmation
scenes.editorial_fact: Actual provider status: SENT · test invoices remain unpaid

scenes.title: Inspect the Sandbox invoice itself.
scenes.caption: PayPal's buyer page shows Alex's invoice, issued October 11, with $52.58 still due. Payment buttons have not been used.
scenes.capture_expected: Actual PayPal Sandbox buyer invoice top: issued 2026.10.11 and amount due US$52.58
scenes.editorial_fact: Korean labels: invoice · issued date · amount due · no live money moved

scenes.title: The reviewed source reaches PayPal.
scenes.caption: The motor, belt, screw and kit retain source IDs L01, L02, L03 and L07 on the invoice. Their shares total $52.58.
scenes.capture_expected: Actual PayPal Sandbox buyer invoice source items, source IDs and US$52.58 subtotal/total

scenes.title: Trace the invoice back to the decision.
scenes.caption: Activity retains draft-to-SENT changes and Alex's SENT-to-SENT refresh with its provider source. The ledger can be exported as JSON.
scenes.capture_expected: Actual activity view with expanded Alex SENT-to-SENT PayPal Sandbox response record and Export ledger button
scenes.editorial_fact: Parts Ledger · a source, a reviewed share, a traceable invoice
